title: Upgrades without downtime
description: Workers before stream and api; migrations old replicas survive; workers report their spec fields. The mixed-version safety of migrations and spec hashes is split out to JS-079, which comes much earlier.
acceptanceCriteria: A rolling upgrade under playback loses no picture

docs/running.md's upgrade section says what an OutputVersion bump costs (every film playing is re-encoded once and its stored segments orphaned), and a bump touches only the specs whose output changed, or the pull request says why it cannot
